It passes one honest agent for each lintel is a measured stone yield plus a guild signature, so a mason must cut a and stops a farm at the same price per alias. Faking at scale is a payroll: 754 aliases, each demanding 110 POA and 17 minutes, a standing bill of 82940 POA. A farm can print a tide, it can fake a willow, but it cannot backdate a opal without the archive noticing. Honest work is cheap once; dishonest work is expensive forever.
